FIELDS.NAME: Surplus Depot
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Surplus Depot specializes in the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment sourced primarily from domestic government auctions and reputable wholesalers. Our operations include a well-organized store where customers can browse a wide range of items, including clothing, gear, camping supplies, and survival equipment. We maintain rigorous inventory management practices, conducting regular appraisals to ensure accurate valuation and traceability of products. The store is equipped with comprehensive fire and water protection systems to safeguard against loss, and we enforce strict access protocols for high-value items. Additionally, all staff members undergo training in regulatory compliance and safe handling of military surplus goods to minimize operational and liability risks.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of inventory from the store on 07/15/2023, caused by a break-in and subsequent inventory loss estimated at $10,000. Currently under investigation. Additionally, accidental damage to merchandise during customer handling on 08/10/2023 totaling $5,000. Both incidents are reported and documented.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sun Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed Safe, Grade 1 security standard, fire-rated for 2 hours, with electronic locking mechanism.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm with video surveillance and on-site security personnel.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Surplus Depot does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The business focuses on retail sales of military surplus and outdoor equipment sourced from government auctions and approved wholesalers.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Surplus Depot does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is primarily on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The primary contractor typically checks and verifies these certificates to ensure compliance and manage risk.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Surplus Depot has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business has maintained its insurance coverage without any issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Surplus Depot does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed by the business.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Surplus Depot carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees in case of work-related injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Surplus Depot does not own or operate any other business; its focus is solely on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Surplus Depot currently has one active insurance policy with this company, identified as policy number SD-2023-001. There are no additional policies with this insurance provider at this time.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Surplus Depot is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The business focuses solely on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment sourced from government auctions and approved wholesalers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Surplus Depot does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Surplus Depot has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business has maintained financial stability and compliance throughout this period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Surplus Depot does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment without engaging in handling such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Surplus Depot does not have any exposure to catastrophes as its operations focus on the retail sale of military surplus and outdoor equipment, and it maintains comprehensive fire and water protection systems.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Surplus Depot has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains strict compliance and oversight in all operational areas.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Surplus Depot has no uncorrected fire code violations and complies with all fire safety regulations. The facility is equipped with comprehensive fire protection systems.
